create_customer: Add a customer. Body: name, phone (text), measurements (an object with chest, waist, hip, length, each a number of inches). Returns the customer including its id.
get_customer: Get one customer by id. Path params: id. 404 if there is no such customer.
create_order: Add an order for a customer. Path params: id (the customer). Body: garment (text), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), price (number of Ghana cedis), deposit (number of Ghana cedis). Returns the order including its id and collected (true/false, false for a new order). Refused when deposit is more than price; 404 if the customer does not exist.
get_order: Get one order by id. Path params: id. Includes collected (true/false). 404 if there is no such order.
list_customer_orders: List all orders of one customer. Path params: id (the customer).
list_due_orders: List orders that are not yet collected and are due on or before a date. Query params: date (YYYY-MM-DD).
collect_order: Mark an order as collected. Path params: id (the order). 404 if there is no such order.
